links.outcome: Test-retest reproducibility of LLM cancer staging across repeated runs
links.effect: Kappa > 0.95 for Mistral Large and Medium; top models test–retest reliability exceeding 97%; smaller and locally deployed models lacked robustness, especially unit conversions and complex staging rules.
links.quote: The top-performing models had a test–retest reliability exceeding 97%, while smaller models and locally deployed versions lacked sufficient robustness, particularly in handling unit conversions and complex staging rules.

unlisted_practices: Stepwise structured prompting (tumour size, nodal status, metastasis) versus direct stage request improves LLM staging accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluated Mistral LLMs on 1000 real-world oncological summaries for cancer staging, explicitly testing whether a stepwise component-based prompt (emulating clinical reasoning) improves performance over direct stage querying.
